## Boundary

Paths begin `tests/unit/`. `D[owner]`=leading string; `C[scope>next]`=maximal full-line region; `<previous>` is a disambiguating preceding-code anchor. Prefix with `tests/unit/<file>#D:` or `#C:<scope>:before:` and, when shown, `:after:`. Each resolves once.

Oracle retains three blobs; parses with `type_comments=True`; strips only allowlisted leading docstrings from current/final copies; normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; requires equal residual ASTs. Targets stay nonempty and shorter; tokens protect inline/unlisted comments. Current/final directive text+attachment (8) and shebangs (zero) stay exact.

## Protection / contracts / consumers
Protect unlisted/inline prose and all runtime material. Retain S2 helper docstrings; S5 `_is_for_structured`, `_structured_consumer_files`, first-response/basename-import notes; headings; 8 directive lines exactly; no shebangs.

Preserve kernel math/veto/reshape/outcomes; provider/provisioning; RP-01 operation/dispatch; RP-04 runtime/op-cert startup; Ruff ratchets; correlation/request/span behavior.

Pytest collects all modules; S5 imports S2. Nested-pytest, Anthropic lazy-import, and environ assert-repr security tests load held-out nodes/source; docs/config cite kernel/Ruff policy. No selected runtime-doc consumer.

## Independent review receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 73 leaf-linked TSV PASS rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.

Before cites the frozen SHA; final cites its full SHA. Require `0 < after_words < before_words` and three PASS fields. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 73 allowlisted blocks are nonempty and shorter; no unlisted prose or executable/runtime material changes.
- [ ] Frozen/current prose identity, current/final normalized AST equality, protected comments, directives, and shebangs pass on all 18 paths.
- [ ] The one leaf commit changes exactly the 18 ordered file-impact paths and has a clean scoped diff.
- [ ] Owned tests, named executable consumers, comment hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] The independent TSV contains exactly 73 fully cited PASS rows from a non-author reviewer.

## Verification
Run all seven structured DD commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, focused, hygiene, and full.
